artifact_observations.reasoning: The image suffers from significant global blur and low resolution, likely due to digital upscaling or poor focus. Edges of the lighter and flame are soft and lack definition.
The flame lacks the complex turbulent structure of a real fire; it appears as a smooth, painted gradient of blue to yellow, typical of AI generation or heavy filtering.
The bottom of the lighter fades indistinctly into the background/shadow without a clear boundary or base cap, suggesting slight geometric melting or grounding issues.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is indeed a lighter and not a similar cylindrical object (e.g., lipstick, battery) given the low resolution.
To analyze the unnatural smoothness of the flame and the global blur to determine if it's a compression artifact or generative failure.
To verify if the base of the lighter is structurally complete or if it merges incorrectly with the background.

focus_areas: Flame structure realism (turbulence vs. smooth gradient)
Boundary sharpness between lighter body and background
Structural integrity of the metal top guard
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the flame's texture. Real flames have chaotic edges; AI flames often look like smooth gradients. Also, check if the metal top guard connects logically to the plastic body or if there is 'floating' geometry.
